Companion to the [LoRa RadioRocket](lora-radiorocket.qmd) build. Each flight the ground
station records is derived into a small [flights.json](lora-flights/flights.json) summary
plus a per-flight CSV of the raw 1 Hz packets; this page reads those directly. **Altitude is
shown AGL** — height above the launch pad — computed as raw barometric altitude minus a
stability-gated pad baseline that locks the instant launch is detected. The baseline and the
window it used are printed with every flight, so any AGL number here can be re-derived.

::: {.callout-note}
**Genesis entry (2026-07-08-F1) is a bench "shake test," not a launch.** A hand-swung sled
tripped launch detection (>3 g), so the state machine and the whole pipeline ran end to end —
but the ~10 ft "peak AGL" is barometric sensor noise, not a climb. It's here honestly, as the
first real over-the-air record.
:::

```{python}
# | echo: false
import json
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", context="talk")
flights = pd.DataFrame(json.load(open("lora-flights/flights.json")))
flights["date"] = pd.to_datetime(flights["date"])
```

## Link quality

```{python}
# | echo: false
# | fig-cap: "Packet loss per record — received vs dropped by sequence number. The genesis entry ran 75 packets with a single drop (1.32%) at RSSI −38…−14 dBm: the RF chain, decoder, and logger working end to end."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 3.5))
sns.barplot(data=flights, x="flight_id", y="loss_pct", color="#dd6b20", ax=ax)
ax.set_ylabel("Packet loss (%)")
ax.set_xlabel("")
plt.tight_layout()
```

## Peak AGL over time

```{python}
# | echo: false
# | fig-cap: "Peak altitude above ground, per record. One entry so far, and it is a hand-swing artifact (~10 ft of barometric noise) rather than a climb — the axis will mean something after the first real launch."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 3.5))
ax.scatter(flights["date"], flights["peak_agl_ft"], s=90, color="#2b6cb0", zorder=3)
ax.set_ylabel("Peak AGL (ft)")
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.margins(x=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
```

## Flight detail

Interactive — pick a flight (or deep-link one with `?flight=<id>`). Traces are the raw
1 Hz packets; altitude is AGL against that flight's locked baseline.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
flightsData = FileAttachment("lora-flights/flights.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selectedFlight = Inputs.select(
  flightsData.map(d => d.flight_id),
  {
    label: "Flight",
    value: (new URLSearchParams(location.search)).get("flight") ?? flightsData[0].flight_id
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sel = flightsData.find(d => d.flight_id === selectedFlight)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="display:flex;gap:.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:.5rem 0 1rem">
  ${vb("Records", flightsData.length)}
  ${vb("Packet loss", sel.loss_pct + "%")}
  ${vb("Best link", d3.max(flightsData, d => d.rssi_max) + " dBm")}
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<p style="line-height:1.6">
  <b>${sel.flight_id}</b> — "${sel.label}" · <b>Peak AGL ${sel.peak_agl_ft ?? "—"} ft</b>
  · ${sel.duration_s}s · ${sel.packets_rx} rx / ${sel.packets_lost} lost (${sel.loss_pct}%)
  · RSSI ${sel.rssi_min}..${sel.rssi_max} dBm · Field ${sel.field}<br>
  <span style="color:#666">Baseline ${sel.baseline_ft} ft over n=${sel.baseline_n}
  (stability-gated pre-boost window) · AGL = raw ALT − baseline.</span>
</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
trace = d3.csv(sel.csv, d3.autoType)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  height: 220, marginLeft: 55,
  x: {label: "T+ (s)"}, y: {label: "Altitude AGL (ft)", grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.line(trace, {x: "MET", y: d => d.ALT - sel.baseline_ft, stroke: "#2b6cb0"})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  height: 200, marginLeft: 55,
  x: {label: "T+ (s)"}, y: {label: "RSSI (dBm)", grid: true},
  marks: [Plot.line(trace, {x: "MET", y: "rssi", stroke: "#dd6b20"})]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  height: 200, marginLeft: 55,
  x: {label: "T+ (s)"}, y: {label: "Acceleration (g)", grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([3], {stroke: "#c53030", strokeDasharray: "4"}),   // launch threshold
    Plot.line(trace, {x: "MET", y: "G", stroke: "#2f855a"})
  ]
})
```
